gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion

definitions.gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion
definitions.explanation: Refers to every instance or occurrence of something. Almost always appears in the pattern その都度 (on each occasion) or verb+都度 (each time something happens).

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}が{起|お}きるたびに、その{都度|つど}{対応|たいおう}している。
examples.english: Each time a problem arises, we deal with it on the spot.

examples.japanese: {必要|ひつよう}な{都度|つど}、{上司|じょうし}に{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report to your supervisor whenever necessary.

examples.japanese: マニュアルはあるが、{状況|じょうきょう}は{毎回|まいかい}{異|こと}なるので、その{都度|つど}{判断|はんだん}するしかない。
examples.english: There is a manual, but since the situation is different every time, we have no choice but to judge on each occasion.

notes:
{都度|つど} almost always appears in fixed patterns rather than being used independently.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- その{都度|つど} (on each occasion, every time)
- [verb]たびに、その{都度|つど} (each time [verb] happens)
- {必要|ひつよう}な{都度|つど} (whenever necessary)
- [noun]の{都度|つど} (on each occasion of)

The pattern その{都度|つど} is by far the most common usage. It emphasizes responding to situations individually as they occur, rather than having a single fixed approach. Common in business and formal writing, but also used in everyday speech.
